notes.title: Combat V2 Update!
notes.notes:
We're very excited to introduce a major update today that changes almost every aspect of the game. Much thanks to everyone that provided much needed feedback in the last year since launch. Let us know any issues, bugs, and feedback via Discord or support email.

NOTE: This update is a significant change from the original game. Existing saves will upgrade to the new resources available but it's recommended to either start a new game or replay the tutorial on another save slot to get familiar with the new combat mechanics.

Combat V2 
A complete overhaul of the combat system based on player feedback. We've heard loud and clear that the original system was too complicated and not all that much fun. The new system increases the lethality of pilots significantly, giving the player more options on how to approach combat encounters.

Pilot weapons can now damage ship hulls. All ship armor and shield upgrades are now tied to sub-systems which pilots can seek out and destroy.
Expanded the pilot holster to include all researched weapons. Pilots no longer have to return to the carrier to change loadouts.
Removed max speed limits from pilot boost upgrades. Moving around the battlefield is easier and this is now a required upgrade due to some new threats mid-campaign.

Campaign Polish 
We revamped the progression tree, research system, and all combat encounters. The feedback was unanimous and similar to the combat system. It was unnecessary complicated. We cleaned up the 6 different resources down to 2. There are now Nanites (for deploying support ships) and Research Cores (for upgrades). Players can use the research cores to progress into their preferred play-styles. Good tactical use of support ships will leave a surplus of Nanites that can be used for further upgrades.

Multiplayer Update
The networking backend has been replaced with a cross-platform capable solution. We're currently working on other platform releases and this is a necessary update for any future cross-platform co-op. The new system utilizes a roomcode system to make it easy to setup co-op games with friends on any platform, while sidestepping a lot of the issues we had with the SteamVR invite system.

Bug Fixes
Too many bugfixes to list. Here's a small preview of the major ones.

Network desync: Fixed jitter on pilot carrier launch.
Network desync: Fixed picking up support flares after throwing.
Network desync: Fixed several weapon shot sync issues.
Network desync: Fixed lance and flare throw physics.
Network desync: Fixed several problems with weapon hit registration. 
Network desync: Fixed several desync issues with smooth locomotion and rotation.
BUG: Fixed frustration around snap turning and teleporting when using Oculus and Index controllers.
BUG: Updated lead prediction on Nuke Torpedo and point defense flak turrets.
BUG: Fixed beam weapon client hit effect if flying backwards.
BUG: Fixed regen and respawns on turrets and ship patrols.
BUG: ... A few dozen more minor ones on the internal list but the todo bug list is empty. If you reported a bug, it's been fixed! Thank you!

If you are missing an anti-armor core and having trouble proceeding in the campaign, head over to Shatter Core and defeat the priority target there to gain a critical core needed to progress.

notes.title: Update notes for March 22, 2023
notes.notes:
March 22, 2023
  - Personal weapon explosive hit effects now only occur if they do effective damage against ship hulls.
  - Increased personal weapon damage against torpedoes and ship turrets by 30%.
  - Additional heavy weapon reloads added during resource tutorial to keep players from having to go back to the ship to re-arm.
  - Decreased the size of the support menu a bit to make it easier to use in combat.
  - Targeting effects are now disabled while using the support menu so they shouldn't clutter up the menu.
  - Minimum range added for weapons targeting larger ships.
  - Removed dash teleport option in favor of an instant teleport with fade due to trouble getting dash teleport effects to play well with smooth rotation options.
  - Fixed a desync issue with smooth rotation when teleporting while rotating.
  - Fixed a desync with beam weapon effects when an origin update occurs.
  - Fixed a case of subspace beacon getting stuck in the player's hand after exiting the commlink station during the campaign.
  - Fixed a few places in stations and carriers that caused flight physics to get stuck.
  - Fixed server/client flight collider mismatch on carrier hangar roofs.
  - Fixed turret damage effects not resetting if a turret resets in another zone from the client.
  - Fixed ship names in the command and ship select menu.
  - Fixed furniture colliders on weapons depot and commlinks not blocking bullets.
  - Fixed some tutorial screens not clearing on exiting the game.
  - Fixed shield breaker effects triggering on some structures when entering a new zone.
  - Fixed handjet boost sound not resetting after exiting field jumps.
  - Fixed issue with Oculus headsets not setting up microphone correctly on startup.
  - Fixed some research voice effects triggering on campaign start.
  - Fixed graphical issue when armor and hull plate modules reset.
  - Networking system multithreading upgrade. Significant performance improvements all around.
